descriptionChirho: Demonstrative pronoun referring to things, concepts, situations, or abstract realities (neuter or general usage), in any case or number.
Demonstrative pronoun referring to specific persons, used as a substantive meaning 'this one, this man, this woman, these people,' in any case, gender, or number.
Demonstrative pronoun used in explanatory or epexegetical constructions, functioning as a discourse marker meaning 'that is to say' or 'namely' (τοῦτ᾽ ἔστιν).
